snippet.title: New Sorting Tidy Up Game with lots of :3 and :D fruits
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5220090/Cozy_Farm_Tidy_Up/

The official announcement trailer for Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
A cozy organizing simulator about sorting 2500+ adorable fruits, vegetables and other crops into greenhouses. Perform satisfying sorting combos, earn money for helpful upgrades and explore the farm at dawn or night. Take your time and tidy the farm, one shelf at a time!

Releasing soon on September 25.

This game is similar to Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! and Sort Them Ducks.

#indiegame #trailer #satisfying
